title: 第0018章 井底的火星子第0019章 井底的叹息草木的命门
lines: 日头毒得像是一把淬了火的钝刀子，在耙耧山的脊背上来回地锯。
药王沟的土路早就干得裂了口子，那些口子像是一张张渴极了的嘴，无声地冲着老天爷要水。路两边的玉米秆子全成了焦黄的纸片子，风一吹，哗啦啦地响，听着就像是成千上万个饿死鬼在拍着巴掌讨饭。
雪见觉得自己的脚底板正踩在一块烧红的铁板上。
她手里紧紧攥着那株刚出土的“雪见草”。草根上还带着点绝命崖底阴湿的泥巴，那是这整片旱地里唯一的一点活气。草叶子白得瘆人，像是一截刚从死人骨头缝里抽出来的筋，在毒太阳底下泛着幽幽的冷光。
背上的半夏发出了一声蚊子哼哼似的动静。那声音细得像是被风吹断的蛛丝，刚一出口，就被周围滚烫的空气给烫化了。
雪见猛地停下脚步，把背上的孩子往上颠了颠。半夏太轻了，轻得像是一把干透了的柴火。这孩子得了绝症，身子骨早就被病魔掏空了，现在又被这大旱天抽干了水分，整个人缩在雪见的背上，像是一个随时会碎掉的泥娃娃。
“半夏，别怕，娘挖到药了。”雪见把脸贴在孩子滚烫的额头上，声音哑得像是在砂纸上磨过，“吃了这药，你就能活。”
其实雪见自己也不知道这草能不能治病。村里的老人说，绝命崖底下长出来的东西，一半是救命的仙丹，一半是催命的毒药。可半夏已经咳出了血，再不吃点什么，就只能等死了。在这药王沟，命比草贱，不搏一把，连个全尸都留不下。
村口的那口老井，是全村人最后的一根指望。
雪见远远地就看见井台边围了一圈人。男人们光着膀子，脊背上的汗水早就被太阳烤干了，留下一层白花花的盐碱印子；女人们头发散乱，手里端着缺了口的粗瓷大碗，眼睛死死地盯着井口，眼神里透着股饿狼般的绿光。
井台边的老槐树早就枯死了，树皮裂得像鱼鳞，树杈上挂着几条褪色的红布条，那是村里人求雨留下的。可老天爷连一滴眼泪都没掉，那些红布条在干风里飘摇，像是一串串上吊的绳子。
“让让！都让让！”
雪见刚挤到井台边，就被一个粗壮的胳膊肘狠狠地顶在了肋骨上。她踉跄了一下，差点把背上的半夏摔下去。
顶她的是村长独活。
独活今天穿了一件洗得发白的蓝布褂子，扣子一直扣到最上面那颗，勒得他脖子上的青筋都凸了起来。他的脸黑得像是一块锅底，一双眼睛却亮得吓人，里面没有半点同情，只有焦躁和算计。
“雪见，你个外来的寡妇，瞎挤个啥？”独活斜着眼睛，目光像刀子一样刮过雪见的脸，最后落在了她紧紧攥着的那株白草上，“手里攥着个啥白毛玩意儿？别是绝命崖上的毒蘑菇吧？”
周围的人都转过头来，几十双眼睛齐刷刷地盯着雪见的手。那些眼神里有怀疑，有嫉妒，还有一丝不易察觉的贪婪。在这连井水都要见底的时候，任何一点跟“药”沾边的东西，都意味着活下去的可能。
雪见下意识地把手往怀里缩了缩，背过身去，用身体挡住了独活的视线。
“不关你的事。”雪见的声音不大，却透着一股子硬邦邦的冷意，“我只要打点水，给半夏熬药。”
“打水？”独活冷笑了一声，那笑声在干热的空气里听着格外刺耳，“你看看这井，还有水吗？连井底的泥巴都干得冒烟了，你拿啥熬药？拿你的眼泪吗？”
雪见没有理会他的嘲讽。她走到井台边，探头往井里看去。
这一看，她的心猛地往下沉了沉。
井里确实没有水。往日里那汪清幽幽的井水早就没了踪影，只剩下一个黑洞洞的深坑。井壁上长着的几丛杂草全都枯黄了，像是一团团乱发贴在石头上。
可是，让雪见头皮发麻的，不是干涸的井底，而是井底深处传来的一股诡异的热气。
那热气不像是太阳晒出来的，倒像是从地心深处往上蒸的。雪见眯起眼睛，死死地盯着井底。在昏暗的光线下，她隐约看到井底的石缝里，竟然冒出了一丝丝微弱的、暗红色的火星子。
那火星子一闪一闪的，像是有什么活物在底下呼吸。
“这井……咋会冒火星子？”雪见喃喃自语，声音里带着一丝连她自己都没察觉到的颤抖。
“啥？火星子？”独活一听这话，立刻像被踩了尾巴的猫一样窜了过来。他一把推开雪见，半个身子探进井口，瞪大了眼睛往里看。
“放屁！哪来的火星子？”独活骂骂咧咧地直起身子，转过头恶狠狠地瞪着雪见，“你个丧门星，是不是想咒死全村人？这井要是着了火，咱们都得给你陪葬！”
“我没骗你。”雪见退后了一步，背上的半夏又发出了一声微弱的**。她深吸了一口气，把怀里的雪见草掏了出来，“我是说，这井底下有邪气。这草，是在绝命崖底挖的，它认得这邪气。”
雪见草刚一露面，周围的人群就发出一阵低低的惊呼。
“那是啥？”
“白得像骨头……”
“绝命崖的东西，碰不得啊！”
独活的眼睛却死死地盯在那株草上，喉结上下滚动了一下。他虽然嘴上骂着邪气，可眼神里的贪婪却怎么也藏不住。在药王沟，越是邪门的东西，往往越值钱。
“雪见，”独活的语气突然软了下来，换上了一副伪善的面孔，“你救孩子的心，我理解。可这绝命崖的草，谁知道有没有毒？不如这样，你把草交给我，我找村里的老中医看看。要是真能治病，我亲自给你熬药；要是不能，你也别白费力气了。”
雪见看着独活那张堆满假笑的脸，心里一阵发寒。
她太了解这个男人了。他叫“独活”，一辈子都在算计着怎么让自己活得更好，哪怕是把全村人的骨头渣子都榨出油来。他把这草要过去，绝不会给半夏治病，只会把它当成敛财或者邀功的筹码。
“村长，”雪见的声音冷得像是一块冰，“这草，是我拿命换来的。半夏等不及，我也等不及。”
说完，她不再理会独活铁青的脸色，转身走到井台边，从旁边的一口破缸里舀了半瓢浑浊的、带着泥沙的存水。
她找了一块干净的石头，把雪见草放了上去。
content_en:
The sun was as poisonous as a blunt knife tempered by fire, sawing back and forth on the back of the mountain.
The dirt road in Yaowanggou has long been cracked with dryness. Those holes are like thirsty mouths, silently asking God for water. The corn stalks on both sides of the road were all turned into burnt yellow paper pieces. When the wind blew, they made a rustling sound, which sounded like thousands of starving ghosts clapping their hands to beg for food.
Xuejian felt that the soles of his feet were stepping on a red-hot iron plate.
She held tightly the newly unearthed "Snow Primrose" in her hand. The grass roots are still covered with a bit of damp mud from the bottom of Jueming Cliff, which is the only vitality in this entire dry land. The grass leaves were horrifyingly white, like a tendon that had just been pulled out from the bones of a dead person, glowing with a faint cold light under the poisonous sun.
"Mother..."
The Pinellia ternata on the back made a sound like a mosquito humming. The voice was as thin as a spider silk blown by the wind. As soon as it came out, it was scalded by the hot air around it.
Xuejian suddenly stopped and bumped the child on his back. Pinellia ternata is too light, as light as a handful of dry firewood. This child was suffering from a terminal illness, and his body bones had been hollowed out by the disease for a long time. Now it was drained of water by this severe drought. His whole body was huddled on Xuejian's back, like a clay doll that could be broken at any time.
"Panxia, don't be afraid, mother has found the medicine." Xuejian pressed her face against the child's hot forehead, her voice was as hoarse as if it had been rubbed on sandpaper, "You can live after taking this medicine."
In fact, Xuejian himself didn't know whether this grass could cure diseases. The old man in the village said that what grows under Jueming Cliff is half life-saving elixir and half life-threatening poison. But Banxia had already coughed up blood, and if she didn't eat something, she would have to wait to die. In Yaowanggou, life is worthless than grass. If you don't fight, you won't even be able to leave a whole corpse.
The old well at the entrance of the village is the last hope for the whole village.
Xue Jian saw a circle of people surrounding the well platform from a distance. The men were shirtless, and the sweat on their backs had long been dried by the sun, leaving behind a layer of white salt-alkali marks; the women's hair was disheveled, holding a large porcelain bowl with a chipped mouth in their hands, and their eyes were staring at the mouth of the well, with a green light like a hungry wolf in their eyes.
The old locust tree beside the well platform has long since died, its bark cracked like fish scales, and a few faded red strips of cloth hung on the branches, which were left by the villagers praying for rain. But God didn't even shed a tear. Those red cloth strips were swaying in the dry wind, like a string of ropes for hanging.
"Give way! Give way, everyone!"
As soon as Xuejian squeezed to the edge of the well, a thick elbow hit her ribs hard. She staggered and almost dropped the Banxia on her back.
The one who stood up to her was the village chief.
Duhuo wore a blue cloth coat that had been washed white today. The buttons were buttoned all the way to the top button, which made the veins on his neck bulge. His face was as dark as the bottom of a pot, but his eyes were frighteningly bright. There was no sympathy at all, only anxiety and calculation.
"Xuejian, you are a foreign widow, what are you trying to do?" Duhuo squinted his eyes, his gaze scraping across Xuejian's face like a knife, and finally landed on the white grass she was holding tightly. "What kind of white-haired thing is you holding in your hand? Isn't it the poisonous mushroom on the cliff of death?"
Everyone around them turned their heads, and dozens of pairs of eyes stared at Xuejian's hand. There was suspicion, jealousy, and a hint of subtle greed in those eyes. At a time when even well water is about to bottom out, anything remotely related to "medicine" means the possibility of survival.
Xuejian subconsciously retracted her hands into her arms, turned her back, and blocked Du Huo's sight with her body.
"It's none of your business." Xuejian's voice was not loud, but there was a strong coldness in it, "I just need to get some water and make medicine for Banxia."
"Fetch water?" Duhuo sneered, and the laughter sounded particularly harsh in the dry and hot air. "Look at this well, is there any water? Even the mud at the bottom of the well is so dry that it is smoking. What are you using to make medicine? Are you using your tears?"
Xuejian ignored his taunt. She walked to the well platform and looked into the well.
At this sight, her heart sank suddenly.
There is indeed no water in the well. The clear and quiet well water in the past has long disappeared, leaving only a dark pit. The few clumps of weeds growing on the well walls were all withered and yellow, like clumps of messy hair stuck to the rocks.
However, what made Xue Jian's scalp tingle was not the dry bottom of the well, but a strange heat coming from the depths of the well.
The heat didn't seem to come from the sun, but rather seemed to be steaming upward from deep within the earth. Xuejian narrowed his eyes and stared at the bottom of the well. In the dim light, she could vaguely see faint, dark red sparks emerging from the cracks in the rocks at the bottom of the well.
The sparks flickered, as if something alive was breathing underneath.
"This well...why are there sparks?" Xuejian murmured to herself, with a tremor in her voice that she was not even aware of.
"What? Xing Xingzi?" When Duhuo heard this, he immediately rushed over like a cat whose tail had been stepped on. He pushed Xuejian away, leaned half of his body into the well mouth, and looked in with wide eyes.
"Fart! Where did the sparks come from?" Duhuo cursed and straightened up, turned his head and glared at Xuejian fiercely, "You loser, do you want to curse the whole village to death? If this well catches fire, we will all be buried with you!"
"I didn't lie to you." Xuejian took a step back, and Banxia on his back let out a weak moan again. She took a deep breath and took out the snow primrose grass in her arms, "I mean, there is evil energy at the bottom of this well. This grass was dug at the bottom of Jueming Cliff, and it recognizes the evil energy."
As soon as Yukimiko appeared, the surrounding crowd let out a low exclamation.
"What's that?"
"As white as bones..."
"Things in Jueming Cliff are untouchable!"
Du Huo's eyes were fixed on the grass, and his Adam's apple rolled up and down. Although he cursed evil on his lips, he couldn't hide the greed in his eyes. In Yaowanggou, the more evil things are, the more valuable they are.
"Xuejian," Duhuo's tone suddenly softened and he put on a hypocritical face, "I understand your desire to save the child. But who knows if the grass in Jueming Cliff is poisonous? Why don't you give the grass to me and I'll find an old Chinese doctor in the village to take a look. If it can really cure the disease, I will personally prepare the medicine for you; if not, don't waste your efforts."
Xuejian felt a chill in her heart when she looked at Duhuo's face full of fake smiles.
She knew this man too well. His name is "Lihuo", and he has spent his whole life calculating how to live a better life, even if it means squeezing the bones out of the entire village. When he asked for this grass, he would never cure Pinellia ternata. He would only use it as a bargaining chip to make money or claim credit.
"Village chief," Xue Jian's voice was as cold as a piece of ice, "I paid for this grass with my life. Banxia can't wait, and I can't wait either."
After saying that, she ignored Duhuo's livid face, turned around and walked to the well platform, scooping half a ladle of turbid water with sediment from a broken vat next to it.
She found a clean stone and placed the snow primrose on it.
title_en: Chapter 0018 The Martian at the Bottom of the Well Chapter 0019 The Sigh at the Bottom of the Well The Life Gate of Plants
